issue.title: 切模型的问题
issue.reportedBehavior: MCP works with one model; after switching in the same conversation, another model says it cannot call MCP.

runtime: Real TransportRegistry, context hydration, SQLite Store, checkpoint serialization and tool dispatch; FakeProvider with synthetic Cursor MCP/context responses.

independentIdentityProbe.difference: Assistant/tool-result internal IDs become cursor-root:* after checkpoint hydration, including when model remains the same.
independentIdentityProbe.relevance: Not evidence of model-switch MCP failure; production consequence and wire serialization impact not established.

limitations: No real Cursor UI model switch, live model inference, MCP server execution or provider HTTP serialization was exercised.
MCP calls were produced by FakeProvider; tests cannot prove a real model will choose the tool.
Covered direct/inline/blob/meta declaration shapes; no assertion about all client-specific declaration changes on model switch.
Registry was recreated with the same Store; this is not a real process restart.

steps: New Agent conversation, choose usable model A and list tabs using Playwright MCP.
In the same conversation choose usable model B and repeat the identical tool call.
Switch back to model A and repeat.
manualTest.passCriteria: All three requests invoke the actual MCP tool and receive results. An empty tab list is a valid result.
